0.content:
Itto, the oni who founded and leads the Arataki Gang, is Shinobu's boss and the centre of her daily headaches. She calls him "Boss" and follows his lead in the gang, but contradicts him openly, returns the snacks and prizes he wins off Hanamizaka's children, and gets him out of jail and every other mess. He says nobody questions him except her and that an angry Shinobu would make his life a nightmare. She admires his resilience: he carries many unpleasant memories yet stays positive and treats the gang well. That is never an excuse for him to run amok, and she promises anyone he wrongs that she will make him regret it.

In The Chasm (2.7) she tried to keep him from starting a fight with Yelan, outed his fear of ghosts, and fed him Roasted Lavender Melon to distract him while the others discussed Liyue secrets. When he fell down a hole, she offered to try not to laugh. In Fontaine (6.4) she sided with the Melusine officers when he swam after an aquabus, telling him it would only escalate if he resisted.

Itto once called her "the pride and joy of the Arataki Gang" and says she takes care of practically everything. When the gang thought she was leaving for a government job (Hangout Event), Itto tore down the flyers he had spent months drawing and organised a tearful farewell, then claimed he had known all along she would never quit.

1.comment: Kuki Shinobu: The Arataki Gang (Akira, Genta, Mamoru, Ushi)
1.content:
The gang is fewer than ten regulars based in Hanamizaka, best known for roasting Lavender Melons, beetle fights, Genius Invokation TCG, The Great Singalong, and getting arrested over unauthorised flyers. Shinobu is deputy leader. Her first act on joining was to beat every member in a "martial demonstration". They were bruised and still asked her to lead them, which told her they were "a big bunch of idiots". She says she stays by choice: they save her the best of everything, and they cheered when she said she would stay. She calls them family and won't hear them insulted.

Since she joined, the gang has added legal consultation, tax agency, event management, tailoring, catering and other licensed services, every certificate signed with her name, and residents praise the transparency of those services. They remain unbounded: the children of Hanamizaka still fear Itto winning their snacks. Ushi, Itto's bull, is the exception; he never joins in anything unlawful, handles errands (he packed for the Fontaine trip), and Shinobu trusts his judgment.

2.content:
Sara, general of the Tenryou Commission, is Shinobu's friend from before the gang. They met when Shinobu delivered a repaired lacquerware figurine to the Police Station, caught it in mid-air when a fleeing thief knocked it flying, and tripped him. Sara hired her part-time to give law lectures and martial demonstrations and attended every one, saying that those who enforce the law should understand it. They meet at an izakaya to trade figurines and drinks, and Shinobu says it is hard to tell who wins when they spar. Sara keeps offering her a post and Shinobu keeps refusing; the civil service is too limiting for her.

Shinobu surrendered her Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree partly so as not to make life hard for Sara. Sara recommends her to clients; in the Hangout Event she arranged for Shinobu to advise a merchant, Norika, on a cross-border medical supply deal. Sara's official introduction calls her well-versed in both literature and martial arts, and says it is a pity she only takes outsourced work.

Shinobu first heard of the Arataki Gang when they held Sara up and made her late to one of their izakaya meetings. When Itto sent Sara an invitation to the gang's 4.6 concert (limited event), Shinobu privately thought that in Sara's place she would have thrown Itto off the roof; Sara sent a basket of Lavender Melons instead.

3.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Miyuki and the Kuki Clan
3.content:
The Kuki Clan has served the Grand Narukami Shrine as shrine maidens for generations and counts it an honour. Shinobu's older sister Miyuki still serves there and wants above all to earn Yae Miko's approval. Shinobu's parents planned her life for her, treated her like a child and nagged her about manners whenever a visitor complained she was not warm enough. They wanted her working at the shrine after her studies; her mother's voice saying so was what The Chasm's door of fears showed her. Miyuki intended to stop her leaving, but changed her mind on seeing the Vision that appeared in Shinobu's bag, and helped win their parents round.

In one branch of her Hangout Event, the sisters meet while clearing gang flyers from the shrine path. Shinobu first claims the gang is "a legitimate international organization" with the Traveler as Chief Advisor; when the truth comes out, Miyuki agrees not to tell the family. Miyuki says Shinobu is no longer a child and the choice is hers, and asks her to make the things she used to talk about come true.

Her 2025 birthday mail says her family sent Naku Weed pouches and charms, the first package since she left that carried only wishes for her safety and success, with no scolding and no request to come home. She made them into a bracelet. Yae Miko has heard plenty about "Miyuki's little sister" and thinks she is fascinating.

4.content:
When she first joined the gang Shinobu wore no mask. During a business negotiation, with the gang lined up silently behind her as instructed, a passing child pointed her out as the shrine maiden from the Grand Shrine who never smiled. Itto struggled not to laugh; the boys failed. The next martial demonstration left their faces redder than hers had been, and gave her the nickname "the demonic deputy". From then on she wore a pitch-black, clawed mask that makes her look positively demonic. She wears it so people will not recognise her and pry into her personal affairs.

The official introduction gives two rules for dealing with her: never try to find out what is under the mask, and never ask why she steers clear of the Grand Narukami Shrine on every job. Even so, old shrine visitors recognise her: the writer Hayato thought she looked familiar, and Granny Asami asked whether she had finally come back.

5.content:
On the day she left the shrine, carrying nothing from her old life, her bag felt too heavy: inside, among the towels, was an Electro Vision. She calls it ironic that a shrine maiden fleeing her duties got a Vision for doing so, and she counts it her first certification, from a god, certifying her freedom. During the Vision Hunt Decree she surrendered it willingly. She did not want to trouble her friend in the Tenryou Commission, it was only one of many certificates, and most problems can be solved without one. She also had to stop the gang from trying to win it back for her.

She now carries it again on her shoulder plate. She says it is solid proof of her capabilities, like any certificate, except that she still does not know what its assessment criteria are.

6.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Yae Miko and the Grand Narukami Shrine
6.content:
Shinobu says being a shrine maiden is unbearably boring ("Even Lady Guuji... has her publishing gig") and that she will never go back. Yae Miko knows her history and loves using it. When the gang plastered flyers on the shrine path ("Why pray to the gods when you can call for the Arataki Gang!"), Shinobu went up to apologise. Yae offered to forgive it if she worked a day as a shrine maiden, hinting at what Tenshukaku might think otherwise. Shinobu said she could deal with most people who exploit her weaknesses, "just not her."

In the branch where she agrees (Hangout Event), she refuses the uniform but spends the day advising visitors. She talks a man out of a too-good-to-be-true overseas investment that she recognises as a scam paying old investors with new investors' money, tells a stuck writer to travel for inspiration, and makes an omamori for an elderly woman whose granddaughter is going abroad. Yae paid her generously, minus the gang's damages, and gave the Traveler a single thin sheet. Shinobu still would not return for any amount of Mora. Yae also offered her editing work at Yae Publishing House; she declined that too.

7.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Yanfei and her Liyue studies
7.content:
Shinobu went to Liyue as an exchange student, partly to escape the shrine, and studied law at Tongwen Academy. Yanfei once taught one of her classes as a substitute one winter, and Shinobu used to meet her to discuss cases, always bowing and thanking her afterwards, which embarrassed Yanfei. Shinobu calls her a walking law encyclopedia and "senpai"; Yanfei expected her to become an excellent lawyer. She was home in Inazuma just before graduating when the Sakoku Decree closed the country, so in 2.7 she and Itto went back to Liyue to collect the certificate. Yanfei rescued Itto from a scrape with the Millelith there. Shinobu holds a law qualification but does not practise, saying the field has too many restrictions for her.

After escaping The Chasm, Yanfei invited Itto and Shinobu for a tour of Liyue. In the 4.3 beetle-battle event (limited) Shinobu called her "Yanfei senpai" and thanked her for helping Itto. In Fontaine (6.4) she planned to buy gifts for Yanfei and Sara.

8.content:
Interlude Chapter Act II (2.7) is Shinobu's first in-person appearance. She and Itto, in Liyue for her graduation certificate, followed Yanfei to The Chasm; Itto picked a fight with Yelan and the ground collapsed under them all. In the Chasm's Bed the group lost all sense of time and stopped feeling hunger or fatigue. Shinobu kept her head: she shared food and water, roasted Lavender Melons to keep morale up, noticed the inconsistent perception of time, and kept Itto busy while the others discussed secrets she judged she and her boss were not supposed to hear. When a door showed each opener their worst fear, she volunteered and heard her mother telling her to give up her books for a shrine job. Her explanation: some cats are meant for the house, others for the wild, and she needs freedom.

The group rescued Xiao from the illusions; Itto blasted open a new path and was left asleep from exhaustion; Yelan and Xiao activated a Fantastic Compass and Xiao used the last of his strength to send the group to the surface; and Zhongli's power saved Xiao as the platform shattered. Shinobu remarked that the human mind is probably both the most complicated and the most tragic of things. Paimon decided she was more capable and reliable than her boss.

9.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Hangout Event: The Gang's Daily Deeds
9.content:
Shinobu's Hangout Event (2.7) begins with her at the Police Station, persuading a doushin to release Mamoru, Akira and Genta. She presents the gang as the "Arataki Support Group" for Itto's excitable temperament, and the Traveler is pressed into vouching. Their crime: flyers for the gang posted all over town, including the shrine path. She lists their recent offences (nearly calling out the fire brigade over roasted melons, a midnight Great Singalong) and plans "a slap on the wrist". Depending on the Traveler's choices, the day goes one of several ways: apologising at the shrine and meeting Yae Miko and Miyuki, writing the Gang Bylaws and chasing the fleeing boys, or simply punishing them and going back to her real plans.

Her real plan was a lunch at Uyuu Restaurant with Sara and the merchant Norika. The eavesdropping boys took it for a job interview with the Shogunate. Itto made them tear down every flyer, return children's snacks, promise a shopkeeper full compensation and stage a teary farewell with a Naku Weed bracelet, before learning she had simply been hired as a legal consultant. She then asked what else they had not told her. Endings: "Unexpected Wages", "Time For Some Secret Dealings...", "Official Business!", "Doom Arrives Just the Same" and "The Arataki Gang Community Service Chronicle". Seeing all of them earns the Traveler the title of Arataki Gang Chief Advisor.

10.content: In one Hangout branch the Traveler suggests written rules instead of beatings, and Shinobu drafts the Gang Bylaws on the spot. Article 1: do not damage other people's property, on pain of full compensation through a gang loan repaid by paid work, with Onikabuto and TCG cards frozen as collateral. Article 2: no bullying small children, on pain of exclusion from all gang activities until forgiven. Article 3 changed with the situation: reciting every bylaw from memory for insubordination, and later, facing Kairagi working for the Fatui, "When one of us is in trouble, all of us come to their aid." She then held classes with "John Doe" test cases. She says the gang obeys the rules because "both my words and my fists are very persuasive."

11.content:
Heizou is a Tenryou Commission doushin unlike the others: Shinobu has never seen him patrol or arrest anyone. He buys street intelligence from her, which the gang gathers easily, and in exchange puts in a good word whenever she is bailing people out of the Police Station. She calls it a good deal. He, in turn, praises the gang's openness and says they are lucky to have Shinobu keeping them in line, though he will not explain how he knows so much.

In the 4.6 concert event (limited) he travelled with Shinobu and talked about the Traveler the whole way; she found him something of a lone wolf.

12.content: Shinobu met the Traveler and Paimon in Liyue when Itto came looking for Yanfei. She caught Paimon's lie at once, then signalled the Traveler to send Itto the wrong way. After The Chasm she treated the Traveler as a trusted friend. She called on them to vouch for the gang at the Police Station, introduced them to Miyuki as Chief Advisor, invited them to her birthdays, and wrote in 2026 that the boys wanted to make the Traveler feel welcome. She says she will never treat them as an outsider, and jokingly holds them to a verbal promise to protect her if she ever leaves the gang ("Tubby can be my witness").

13.content: Shrine lore says a ring of Naku Weed wrapped round the body wards off disaster. As a child at the shrine Shinobu tried the same kind of remedy, a loop of thorny plants, to cure a chill while praying all night; it failed and left a red mark. Later a herbology book told her those mountain thorns paralyse birds and beasts, which is why the ancients used them to numb aches. She finds the paralysing effect "a little more practical": she makes throwing darts from it and offers to teach their use. Ironically, the gang's farewell gift in her Hangout Event was a Naku Weed bracelet, and her family later sent her Naku Weed charms.

14.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Xiangling and Wanmin Restaurant
14.content: As a law student in Liyue, Shinobu often ate at Wanmin Restaurant and was amazed by its range, though she already had a high-level culinary licence. When she remarked that breakthroughs come from daring to surpass your predecessors, the sous chef, Xiangling, urged Chef Mao to bring out Salt and Pepper Slime. Years later her Roasted Lavender Melon made the Arataki Gang weep with joy; she never told them she had glazed it with slime ooze. She now agrees with a Liyue saying, "There is no bad food, only bad cooks."

15.comment: Kuki Shinobu: The Letter of the Law (Fontaine, 6.4)
15.content: In a Travelers' Tales anecdote (6.4), the Traveler finds Shinobu by a fountain in the Court of Fontaine, advising Yamada, a business owner on her first overseas venture, on licences, scheduling and marketing. Yamada had paid the whole gang's travel. Itto, Akira, Mamoru and Genta jumped into the aquarail waterway to race an aquabus, and Genta could not swim. When a Melusine officer, Menthe, came to arrest them, Itto boasted of his "top-notch lawyer"; Shinobu told him to can it and offered eyewitness testimony herself. She expected their detention to end in time to collect them on the way home, and thought the Fortress of Meropide's different management style would broaden the boss's horizons. Ushi, who never joins the gang in anything unlawful, stayed free and kept her company.

16.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Thoma and the housekeeping licence (5.7)
16.content: In a Travelers' Tales anecdote (5.7), Shinobu looks into the Yashiro Commission's housekeeping courses, which Thoma explains to her, because a Domestic Services Provider License would let the gang take more repair and cleaning jobs. Everyone except her was unemployed again: Itto scrubbed skin off bathhouse customers, and Akira ate three skewers for each one he grilled at Shimura's. She decided to get the licence first and tutor them herself.

17.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Shinobu at festivals and events
17.content:
Limited-time event appearances, canon but not universally known:
- Duel! The Summoners' Summit! (3.7): she got through the qualifiers of a Genius Invokation TCG tournament at Ritou (Itto did not), lost fair and square to Sangonomiya Kokomi, refereed a match, and told Itto no one could win with his deck.
- Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp (4.3): Itto's beetle-battle training in Liyue's Guyun Stone Forest with Yanfei, Xiangling, Guoba and Grandmaster Hanakado. When Itto talked of studying, she offered to write him a starter booklet, then hurried him to the harbour on boat tickets bought with their last Mora.
- Receiver of Friends From Afar (4.4): at Wangshu Inn with Itto (working as a sailor) and Kamisato Ayato. She helped cook, mentioning her Liyue senior culinary licence, and made sure the guests ate before Itto finished everything.
- Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness (4.6): she delivered the invitations to the gang's concert and handled the guests.
- Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival (5.4): kept Itto on an advertising job and offered her services as a "licensed game designer".
- Reel Ad-Venture (5.4): a film-editing event in which she appears in behind-the-scenes shots and suggests the editor take an advanced editing certificate.
